caption: The drawing depicts architectural iron brackets used for supporting sheds and balconies, rendered in black ink on a beige background. At the top left corner, there is a triangular bracket with scrollwork and dimensions marked as 52 inches by 40 inches. The upper central section (labeled "A") illustrates a perspective view of a shed roof, showing multiple decorative iron brackets installed at the corners and supporting a rectangular overhang with linear shading to indicate structure. The text "SHED and BALCONY BRACKETS of IRON" is written vertically along the right-center portion of the drawing. Below this, a similar arrangement (labeled "B") displays another type of scrollwork bracket supporting a different overhang, with the bracket dimensioned in the lower right corner as 36 inches by 30 inches. Both brackets feature ornate, swirling patterns and leaf motifs. The entire composition is framed by a single-line rectangular border.
title: Wrought Iron Brackets
